listenChars.name: Amir
listenChars.role: WKU student, applying for a summer internship

listenChars.name: Ms. Dinara
listenChars.role: HR manager at a tech company in Almaty

listenStatements.text: He has prepared a portfolio of his coding projects.
She says the internship involves working on real client projects.
He says he works well in a team and loves solving problems.
She asks him to describe a time he overcame a challenge.
He explains that he once led his group project when the team leader was ill.
She offers him the internship and says he will start in July.
